acquisition method: The resulting MS/MS data were acquired in the data-independent acquisition (DIA) scan mode and processed using MaxQuant search engine (v.1.6.15.0).
cleavage agent: The extracted protein solution was digested with trypsin at 1:50 trypsin-to-protein mass ratio for the first digestion overnight and 1:100 trypsin-to-protein mass ratio for a second 4 h-digestion.
fragmentation method: The timsTOF Pro was operated in parallel accumulation serial fragmentation (PASEF) mode.
instrument: The peptides were subjected to a capillary source followed by the timsTOF Pro (Bruker Daltonics, Billerica, USA) mass spectrometry.
ionization type: The electrospray voltage applied was 1.60 kV.
labeling: Abundance intensity analysis further revealed that milk proteins, including CSN2, CSN3, CSN1S1, CSN1S2, LGB, and LALBA, exhibited high expression levels in the lactating organoids (Fig. 5F).
